historical_actor_bridge.scope: Exact path/input bridge for all recorded observations and both 512-update before/after SFT arms. No changed record is silently adopted. Future corrected-runtime behavior and PPO still need actual evaluation.

independent_exposure_scope: Two newly executed corrected-input teaching rounds. All prior fixed weights are historical controls on this same corrected exam. Original independent components were partly observed during a failed old-runtime evaluation; no independent labels enter training, checkpoint selection or recipe tuning. This is not a newly untouched holdout. Completed development and all qualification attempts are inherited without policy inference. A reproduced 4096-call engine fuse is a certified unknown prefix, never a natural win or loss.

sampling_uncertainty: Descriptive fixed-component/four-fit-deck evaluation with correlated paired seats. Unknown-outcome bounds are not statistical confidence intervals or human-ladder guarantees.
interpretation: Engineering completion does not imply superior play. Old-skill regressions, failed transfer and unknown/invalid duels remain reported; no default model is promoted.
